title: Projective cofibrancy of coherent join-cone weights
statement:
Fix universes and small simplicial sets as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and use the subset-poset coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. Let $K$ be any small simplicial set, let $A=\mathfrak C[K]$, and let $b$ and $t$ denote the new vertices of $\Delta^0\star K$ and $K\star\Delta^0$, respectively. Composition defines enriched functors
$$W^-_K:A\longrightarrow\mathsf{sSet},\qquad W^-_K(a)=\mathfrak C[\Delta^0\star K](b,a),$$
$$W^+_K:A^{\mathrm{op}}\longrightarrow\mathsf{sSet},\qquad W^+_K(a)=\mathfrak C[K\star\Delta^0](a,t).$$
Both weights are projectively cofibrant in the following explicit sense. For $B=A$ and $W=W^-_K$, or $B=A^{\mathrm{op}}$ and $W=W^+_K$, the map $\varnothing\to W$ in enriched functors $B\to\mathsf{sSet}$ is a retract of a transfinite composite, continuous at limit stages, of pushouts of coproducts of the free boundary maps
$$B(a,-)\times\partial\Delta^r\longrightarrow B(a,-)\times\Delta^r,\qquad a\in\operatorname{Ob}(B),\quad r\geq0.$$
Here $\partial\Delta^r$ is the union of the proper faces of $\Delta^r$, $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$, and all functor colimits and products with simplicial sets are computed at each object. No Kan condition on $A$ or finiteness condition on $K$ is imposed.

source.place: Riehl–Verity, Recognizing quasi-categorical limits and colimits in homotopy coherent nerves, Definition 5.2.8 and Lemma 5.2.9, printed p.34, using Theorem 5.2.6, pp.32–34. The right-cone version is the opposite of the left-cone version. Read the authors’ online PDF; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this simplicial-enriched result.
